name: preset_whitespace
first_used: built 2026-10-22 (kit v11) from the owner's asks on films/oss-editor: holistic not heavy, a white background, face-off scenes, the camera on him; not yet approved on a sample
default_for: new talking-head edits, 16:9 long-form and samples (decision 2026-10-22); preset_canvas_studio stays available and renders as before
engine: kit/hf/canvas.js: HF.canvas(K, ROOT, { ..., look: "whitespace" }); HF.studio / HF.reel { look: "whitespace" } (kit/hf/studio.js HF.studioLook)
tokens: kit/hf/core.js HF.LOOKS.whitespace (C, F) and HF.LOOKS.whitespace.stage; the values below mirror them

format.render: 1080p for previews and samples; 4K only for a final he asks for

palette.falloff: true white over the middle 55 %, about 3 % darker in the far corners

use.e3: the scene's one hero object: a window, the hero card, his shape

type.title: Inter 700, -0.025 em, 44-56 px on cards (.cv-t)
type.label: Inter 500, 32-36 px (.cv-s); chips Inter 600 32 px
type.kicker: JetBrains Mono 500, 26-28 px, uppercase, 0.14 em, sub (6:1 on white; mute is 3.8:1, for 32 px and up only)
type.min_rule: body text and labels >= 32 px; the kicker is the one exception, >= 26 px and always in sub

pieces.beam: 4 px ink line (max 5 px), no glow, an accent node r 8 in a white ring
pieces.highlight: a solid #E4DFFF marker, multiply, full strength
pieces.chart: one accent stroke 6 px over a flat 4.5 % tint, hairline grid, 2 px base, no glow or halo, white tip in an accent ring
pieces.speaker: his graded room in a rounded card (r 32) or a circle, e3 shadow; no glow ring, no back block
pieces.blocks: neutral #F3F3F5 whatever colour is named, a hex included (stage.blocks; avoid them)
pieces.cards: land once, then hold still: stage.driftMax 0 caps any drift a template passes (like the beam's wMax); pass none
pieces.palette: a film's palette acc is the one accent: the kit's components and the stage (grad, beam node, chart, the marker at 17 % on white)
pieces.diagram: HF.diagram style flat (the default on this look; kit/refs/DIAGRAMS.md): hairline boxes on a 4 px grid, mono tags, one focal box (accent tint, raised to e3), straight or right-angle connectors that never share a port, a loop's way back dashed under the row with a caps label; budgets 5 nodes (4 on 9:16), 6 edges, 2 focal, labels <= 14 characters

restraint.one_idea_on_screen: one hero object + one supporting chip or source line + him
restraint.motion: the camera carries the energy; elements land once, then stay still (the engine caps drift at 0 on this look)

speaker.rule: never cut out: full frame or a closed shape with his graded room; his room as shot (no blur, dim, vignette or whitening)

seated_full_frame.crop: a clean rect of his plain wall

speaker.motion_blur: on his footage only from fast camera moves (whips, zoom-throughs)

takeover_recipes.statement: kicker (mono caps 26-28 px, sub) + C.big (Inter 700) + the one mark (accent word or a drawn underline) + at most one 32-36 px line; C.hold push
takeover_recipes.system_diagram: 3-4 C.card (e2), the hero raised to e3 with the accent numeral, C.beam ink lines with accent nodes drawing on the links, one chip
takeover_recipes.evidence_close_up: C.window (real capture or a generic mock) at e3, C.highlight on the one line, a dated source chip, the camera pushes into the line

grade.footage: the 'clean' look offered as an A/B against the current look

audio.bed: one calm bed (lo-fi, chill, soft piano), long-form 18 dB under the voice with a voice-keyed duck (no pumping); Reels about 12 dB

transitions: our own code: camera whips, pushes and pull-outs, his shape morphing, hard cuts; no shader transitions

qa.still_sheet: uv run python kit/presets/whitespace/sheet/build.py --room <take> && node kit/presets/whitespace/sheet/shoot.mjs (fails if a landed card moves)
